prompt: Run the llm-working2grid ablation baseline for as-twn-kaohsiung-shape-rect (orig): place every exported point on a grid cell, deciding each coordinate by reasoning, not by an algorithm.

transcript.note: Round 1, laid out from geography alone (no baseline in this chain). Read the topology first: the light-rail ring 4-11-6-7-14-16-0-3-15-13 encloses 8 美麗島, and both other lines radiate from 8 through the ring (Red 3-8-7, Orange 4-8-16). So I built the ring as a rectangle with 8 at its centre. Criterion 1 (branch points first): I fixed the five deg>=3 points 3/4/7/8/16 by their real bearings before anything else -- e.g. at 8 the CCW cycle is 3(85deg),4(190deg),7(307deg),16(358deg), which I reproduced as N,W,S,E. Criterion 2 (one line, one direction): Orange became the single row 3 (4,8,16,10,12 all at row 3, all four segments horizontal); Red became the single column 2 (9,5,3,8,7 at col 2, four vertical segments); the ring became the rectangle cols 0-3 x rows 2-5, left edge 11-4-13-15 at col 0, top edge 15-3-0 at row 5, right edge 0-16-14 at col 3, bottom edge 14-7-6-11 at row 2. Criterion 3 (compass): I assigned columns and rows as monotone bands of gx and gy, so no pair of points can flip east/west or north/south -- only distances are squashed. Two segments cannot be axis-aligned: 1 岡山 cannot join the Red column because 6 軟體園區 (gx 224) lies between 1 (208) and 8 (235) and would then sit either on top of 7 or in the middle of the 8-7 segment; and 2 小港 cannot join it either (that would drag 9,16,0,14,10 in with it). I gave both 45deg instead, leaving row 1 empty so 7->2 spans two rows and two columns -- that empty row is the genuinely long southern run out to 小港, which also gives placeBlacks room for its intermediate stations. Criterion 4: the two dense clusters (哈瑪星/光榮碼頭/鼓山/內惟藝術中心 in the west, 美麗島/凹子底/凱旋 in the centre) sit in adjacent cells; the long empty stretches east to 大寮 and north to 岡山 are compressed to single steps.
